_readme: Example config for the electrical-contact / cutting-mask placement stage.
Runs AFTER grid_preperation -- point grid_preperation_output_dir at a real
grid_preperation --output folder (needs its flakes/ and cif/ subfolders,
plus the working template copy it produced).
All geometry numbers below are transcribed from contact_placement/materials/prompt.docx
-- see contact_placement/config.py's own field docstrings for the exact spec sentence
each one corresponds to. Units are real microns (um), same as everywhere else in this pipeline.
_comment_flake_filter: min_flake_score is flake_detection's OWN final_score (not re-derived -- grid_preperation just transforms flake_detection's real contour+score through its own calibration, see CifExportConfig.flake_detection_output_dir). No separate marker filter needed -- flake_detection already excludes marker/grid-dot regions before scoring.
_comment_chip_border_margin_um: No contact/cutting-mask geometry may be placed within this many um of the chip/die's real edge (derived from the working template's own B/P content, see cif_export.chip_bounds_from_cif) -- shrinks that boundary inward on all four sides before Hall/Ring placement.
_comment_user_tunable: These are the 'popping UI' parameters from the spec -- set here for headless/CLI runs, adjustable in the UI before committing to export.

ring._comment_ring_measurements: Per the spec's updated 'Ring:' measurements section. inner_ring/outer_ring are explicit min/max/step search ranges (config.frange); distance_between_arms/arm_width/finger_width are fixed constants, not searched.
